sources.excerpt: Big Ben Overdrive by VOX | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE VOX Big Ben Overdrive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE Description The effect pedals in the COOLTRON series are clearly pedal mines of a special kind. After all, they contain a genuine 12AU7 preamp tube, which stands for bite, warmth and tons of fat, but is still not a battery guzzler. A power supply unit is an optional extra in the truest sense of the word: nice, but not indispensable. Your amp sounds warm and silky. And it should - even if you really go into the red zone! Like a true gentleman, the Big Ben Overdrive respects your playing dynamics. But that's not to say that it can't also turn up the heat when your umbrella, charm and bowler hat are temporarily out of place. With the GAIN control, you can explore the whole range between bluesy warmth and fat overdrive. Use TONE to adjust the tone color. Like the other COOLTRON pedals, the Big Ben also pays homage to the true bypass circuit. No effect therefore means that input equals output. Vox Vox Cooltron series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Vox CT-02 Big Ben Overdrive Published on September 16, 2005 Vox Cooltron series overdrive pedal Controls Volume Tone Gain Effect Information Vox Preserve your amp's warm, silky tone while pushing your sound into overdrive! The tube-powered Big Ben Overdrive pedal responds to your playing dynamics and cranks out that extra firepower when you really dig in and want to cut through. The Gain knob varies the overall gain of the pedal from bluesy and mellow to fat and saturated, while the Tone knobs adjusts that overall tonality of the pedal. As with all COOLTRON pedals, the Big Ben's true bypass allows you to let your signal flow through untouched. Big Ben Overdrive controls - Gain, Tone, Volume, True Bypass Tube: 12AU7 Power: 4 x AA batteries (allows 16 hours of operation) Dimensions: 1 6.84 cm (6.63") (W) x 15.55cm (6.12") (H) x 6.4cm (2.52") (D) Weight (excluding batteries): Bulldog Distortion 1.07kgs (2.36 lbs.), Big Ben Overdrive 1.02kgs (2.25 lbs.), Brit Booster 1.05kgs (2.31 lbs.)
